name: references
title: Source publications for linkage-map records
description: One row per publication cited in the Stapley et al. (2017) compilation. Derived from the published supplementary reference list (rstb20160455_si_003.pdf) with bibliographic metadata resolved from Crossref. The verbatim citation text is retained so no field depends on trusting the automated match.

fields.name: ref_id
fields.title: Reference key
fields.description: Stable citekey: lowercase first-author surname + year, with a/b/c suffixes to disambiguate. Primary key.

fields.name: doi
fields.title: DOI
fields.description: Lowercase DOI without resolver prefix. Null where no DOI could be found.

fields.name: doi_url
fields.description: Resolver URL, https://doi.org/<doi>.

fields.name: authors
fields.description: Full author list. 'Family, Given; Family, Given' from Crossref; verbatim citation style where no DOI.

fields.name: n_authors
fields.description: Author count from Crossref. Null where no DOI.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year. From Crossref where available, else the supplement.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Article title, markup stripped.

fields.name: journal
fields.description: Journal / container title.

fields.name: journal_normalized
fields.description: Journal name with known surface variants unified (PLoS ONE/PLOS ONE, G3 with and without colon). Use this for grouping; `journal` preserves what Crossref returned.

fields.name: journal_abbrev
fields.description: ISO abbreviation from Crossref where supplied.

fields.name: volume
fields.description: Volume. String, not integer — some are non-numeric.

fields.name: pages
fields.description: Page range. Some are truncated in the source PDF; see review_note.

fields.name: publication_type
fields.description: Crossref work type, e.g. journal-article.

fields.name: crossref_citation_count
fields.description: Times-cited count at time of retrieval (2026-08). Snapshot, not a live value.

fields.name: si_ref_number
fields.description: Reference number in the 2017 supplementary list. Join key to SuppDat.csv Ref.number.

fields.name: si_first_author
fields.description: First-author surname as printed in the supplement. Retained for traceability.

fields.name: si_year
fields.description: Year as printed in the supplement. May disagree with `year`; see flag_year_mismatch.

fields.name: citation_verbatim
fields.description: Citation exactly as it appears in the supplementary PDF. The provenance anchor for every other field.

fields.name: match_confidence
fields.description: high = automatic Crossref match above threshold; high_manual = verified or supplied by hand; unresolved = no DOI.

fields.name: match_title_score
fields.description: Fuzzy token-set similarity (0-100) between supplement title and Crossref title.

fields.name: match_author_score
fields.description: Fuzzy similarity (0-100) between supplement and Crossref first-author surname.

fields.name: manual_review
fields.description: Set where a match was inspected by hand.

fields.name: review_note
fields.description: Why a match was accepted or rejected, or what is truncated in the source.

fields.name: flag_year_mismatch
fields.description: Supplement year differs from the DOI record year. 41 records.

fields.name: flag_author_list_incomplete
fields.description: Crossref lists materially fewer authors than the citation.

fields.name: flag_no_doi
fields.description: No DOI found; bibliographic fields come from the citation text only.
